name: Nima mislivicja
source:
"The Silent Huntress" is a visual novel in the genre of a dark fairy tale with choices and different endings. A young girl named Gerda tracks down the Monster to revenge him for killing her younger brother. On the way, she meets fantastic creatures she has never seen before and in whose existence she did not believe. But this does not shake her determination to hunt down the Monster.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121480/]Steam[/url]]
